scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @bkyexam-practice/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @bkyexam-practice/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @bkyexam-practice/api && npm run build -w @bkyexam-practice/web && npm run build -w @bkyexam-practice/admin
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:integration:db: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration:db -w @bkyexam-practice/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run docs:audit && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:db: npm run verify && npm run test:integration:db
scripts.verify:docker: npm run verify && npm run test:integration:db:docker
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @bkyexam-practice/admin
